## Context / Problem
Each review pass embeds its own full copy of the plan with no cross-pass cache reuse; the only shared bytes (~130-token preamble) sit below Anthropic's 1024-token cacheable minimum. Timing data shows inter-pass gaps of 50-100ms, so a prefix written in Pass-1 stays warm through Pass-2 under the default TTL. Separately, incremental-depth BLOCK loops (each round exposing one more layer) need an exhaustiveness instruction in the shared finder stance. The two passes render through DIFFERENT paths today: Pass-1 finder via passes._resolve_system (src/rebar/llm/plan_review/passes.py:276-293 — whole prompt rendered, no volatile split; src/rebar/llm/reviewers/plan_review_finder.md has NO <!--volatile--> marker), while Pass-2 verify renders via the workflow RunnerAgentStep (src/rebar/llm/workflow/runs.py) -> prompts.resolve_prompt_cached, which splits on the <!--volatile--> marker already present in src/rebar/llm/reviewers/plan_review_verifier.md (~:173) with the {{plan}} variable on the VOLATILE side — so the plan is currently uncached for the verifier.

## Approach
Create one shared plan-prefix source and route both passes through it: (1) a new helper in src/rebar/llm/prompting/prompts.py, shared_plan_prefix(plan) -> str, producing the byte-stable block [shared stance preamble + plan material]; (2) plan_review_finder.md restructured to [prefix segment containing {{plan}}] + <!--volatile--> marker + [finder rubric segment], and passes._resolve_system KEEPS its current strip_volatile_marker behavior — the whole rendered template remains the system prompt, byte-preserving Pass-1 runtime semantics; the marker's role in the finder template is structural (it defines where the shared prefix ends, asserted by the byte-identity tests), and the template is reordered so the rendered output's leading bytes equal shared_plan_prefix(plan) exactly; no switch to split_volatile on the Pass-1 path; (3) BOTH verifier prompts restructured — src/rebar/llm/reviewers/plan_review_verifier_agentic.md (the agentic arm, the primary production gate path) and src/rebar/llm/reviewers/plan_review_verifier.md (the single-turn arm) — so {{plan}} moves into the STABLE segment (before its existing volatile marker) laid out identically to the finder's prefix segment; (4) src/rebar/llm/workflow/runs.py's RunnerAgentStep rendering path is enumerated as a consumer and verified unchanged in mechanism — it already splits on the marker; only the template content moves — with a regression test pinning that the rendered verifier stable segment equals shared_plan_prefix(plan) byte-for-byte. (5) The exhaustiveness directive is added to the shared stance preamble (one sentence: enumerate every independent defect found in this run; do not defer deeper findings to a later round), so it reaches every Pass-1 request via the shared prefix. Container/ISF/coach prompts are NOT restructured in this change (different prompt_ids, separate cache entries today, unchanged behavior) — follow-up work if the measured savings justify it. Alternative rejected: raising the cache TTL to 1 hour — measured pass gaps never approach the 5-minute refresh-on-hit window, and revise-loop re-reviews change the prefix bytes, so the 2x write premium buys nothing.

## Scope
src/rebar/llm/prompting/prompts.py (shared_plan_prefix helper), src/rebar/llm/plan_review/passes.py (_resolve_system layout), src/rebar/llm/reviewers/plan_review_finder.md (add volatile marker + prefix segment), src/rebar/llm/reviewers/plan_review_verifier.md (move {{plan}} into the stable segment), src/rebar/llm/reviewers/plan_review_verifier_agentic.md (same restructure — primary path), src/rebar/llm/workflow/runs.py (consumer audit; no mechanism change expected), src/rebar/llm/plan_review/fidelity_spot_eval.py (its RELOCATED_PROMPTS list and _relocation_requests reference the verifier prompt via resolve_prompt_cached — updated for the restructured templates), tests/unit/workflow/test_shared_prefix.py (new).

## Testing
Unit (relative imports): for one fixture ticket, the Pass-1 finder system prompt's leading bytes and the RunnerAgentStep-rendered Pass-2 verifier STABLE segments (BOTH the agentic and single-turn verifier prompts) are byte-identical to shared_plan_prefix(plan); the prefix exceeds 1024 estimated tokens for a typical plan fixture; the exhaustiveness directive appears in every Pass-1 request; the verifier's volatile segment still carries the per-run finding listing; existing plan-review workflow fixture tests pass with unchanged verdict behavior.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Pass-1 finder system prompts and the rendered stable segments of BOTH verifier prompts (agentic and single-turn) share a byte-identical leading prefix equal to shared_plan_prefix(plan), containing the full plan material (checked: `pytest tests/unit/workflow/test_shared_prefix.py` comparing all three).
- [ ] The shared stance preamble contains the exhaustiveness directive and it reaches every Pass-1 request (checked: unit test over recorded requests).
- [ ] The verifier's per-run finding listing remains in the volatile segment (checked: unit test asserting the listing is absent from the stable segment).
- [ ] Review verdict behavior on existing workflow fixtures is unchanged (checked: existing plan-review workflow tests pass unmodified).
